{{Quote|Okay, then that leaves Reseda Squadron for the general approach.|Jagged Fel describing the battle plan for the Battle of Galantos|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant" />}}
'''Reseda Squadron''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that was fought in the [[Battle of Galantos]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The squadron was assigned to make a direct approach on the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant" />
